courses.title: Architectural Visualization Techniques
courses.description: Architectural Visualization Techniques takes you from the basics of architectural visualization to applying it on a realistic Architectural Visualiser scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to cad modeling, enough to use it alongside architectural visualization day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying architectural visualization to a real Architectural Visualiser scenario
Practicing architectural visualization through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to cad modeling
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

It's built for people who already have some grounding in animation basics and want to go further.

alternates.title: Advanced Architectural Visualization Techniques
